passages.excerpt_preview: The city magistrates are ordered to go out every five years and instruct the people in dhamma.

passages.locator: wishes them no fear or injury
passages.excerpt_preview: The people of the unconquered borderlands should know that the king wishes them no fear or injury but happiness.

passages.locator: welfare and happiness in this world and in the next
passages.excerpt_preview: As I desire for my children welfare and happiness in this world and in the next, so do I desire for all men.
